en.name: Server Console
en.description: Manage Linux hosts over your local SSH connection. Inspect resources, systemd services and Docker containers, read logs and review fixed management actions. Agents use host-bound expiring grants. Requires a desktop App with SSH support; credentials and results stay private.

zh.name: 服务器
zh.description: 通过本机 SSH 管理 Linux 主机：查看资源、系统服务与 Docker 容器，读取日志并确认启停操作。支持绑定具体主机的 Agent 限时授权。连接信息与命令结果不写入共享页面，需支持 SSH 的桌面 App。
